subject: Nice read, again...
author: SUFFUR
body:
But what happened to your formating, lol, as you guys must know my interviews when they do get posted, Zon/Xan, are edited after i send them it, so it's professional like, lol.

I like your bike stuff and if it's linked to stuff should not be too much of a hassle, but send me the link via pm i'm interested. And i know how that guy feels, i know it seems odd but if i stub my toes, did that the other day all of them at the same time and i feel it, i'm happy, as it means i can feel my feet, which does not happen often, and i stub my toes a lot and don't realize till i see the blood trail, and i'm more worried about the mess, and cleaning it up, lol. But that guy has some sllab, and does ytihs have  two t's or not, lol.

Anyway (I'm really sorry this is really a bad word now) keep up the writting when you got the time, it is interesting, but the formating needs sorting I kept reading the same sentence's over again, but that could be my dyslexia, lol.

And Boot will be back one day to kick ass for a few hours just to say he can, but it does prove the point Revenge is getting old, and saddly, unless Criterion add some more tracks it will saddly fade as one of the best arcade racers on the 360!

But it will not be sunsetted for at least a year yet, maybe more if Pysc has any say, lol.

Damn, you do like Revenge though, to Race the Germans and the Italians, they don't muck about, I use to race 'em because they played the game the way it was supposed to be, nasty, dirty and to win and kill everyone along the way, though they can gang up on you if you kick their sessa to much, lol.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
